statement: The survivor count and the minimal-certificate count of Paper B are one recursion. Let N_d = neverNegCount d count the length-d parity words no prefix of which contracts and M_d = minimalCertCount d the minimal certificates of length d. (i) neverNegCount_add_minimalCertCount: N_(d+1) + M_(d+1) = 2 N_d, by one extension step -- extending a survivor by a letter either contracts for the first time, which is what a minimal certificate of the new length is, or survives, and the two outcomes are disjoint and exhaustive (prefixNoncontracting_concat, isMinimalCertificate_concat, extensions_eq_survivors_union_certs). (ii) certifiedWordCount_succ: the certified count satisfies #C_(d+1) = 2 #C_d + M_(d+1). (iii) density_succ: so the certificate density gains exactly M_(d+1)/2^(d+1), the cylinder measure of the new minimal certificates -- PaperBFiveStepDensity.five_cylinders_card_sum is this at depth five, read across the five words at once. (iv) minimalCertCount_eq_zero_of_window_empty and density_flat_of_window_empty: an empty odd-count window (J-paper-b-certificate-length-window) leaves no minimal certificate, so the density does not move; density_flat_five_to_six, density_flat_eight_to_nine and density_flat_ten_to_eleven are corollaries, giving 7/8 at d = 5 and 6, 237/256 at d = 8 and 9, and 15/16 at d = 10 and 11. The plateaus are therefore proved rather than enumerated. Combinatorics only: no exponential sum, no density for the Juggler map, and no evaluation of M_d when it is nonzero. DUPLICATION, RECORDED 18 September 2026. This identity was already known as J-count-recursion-is-the-boundary-mass in the equivalent shape N_(d+1) = 2 N_d - b_d M_d, with M_d the survivors sitting ON the barrier and b_d the Sturmian rise, whose three branch cases are kernel-checked in PaperBBarrierStep. It was written here without knowing that, which is a search failure and not a second result. What this row adds is the piece that row names as missing: it says the cardinality bookkeeping joining the branches 'is the sentence above and is not formalised', and neverNegCount_add_minimalCertCount is exactly that bookkeeping, in Nat arithmetic with no real number. The two shapes are joined by minimalCertCount_succ: minimalCertCount (d+1) = onBarrierCount d, proved through minimalCertWords_succ, which shows the minimal certificates of length d+1 are exactly the E-extensions of the on-barrier survivors of length d. The bridge is not_exponentGap_concat_odd -- a survivor's ODD extension can never contract, since surviving gives 2^d <= 3^o and so 3^(o+1) >= 3*2^d > 2^(d+1) -- so no minimal certificate ends in O and onBarrierCount counts b_d M_d without naming b_d. Checked against the counts at every d = 0..299.
